_comment: Tier-2: contact surfaces must be SubModelParts holding CONDITIONS of a Mortar type, not Elements. Pitfall (kratos.contact #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The distinction is a registry fact and is checked both ways for three mortar names: ALMFrictionlessMortarContactCondition2D2N, ALMFrictionalMortarContactCondition2D2N and PenaltyFrictionlessMortarContactCondition2D2N all construct via CreateNewCondition, and all three raise RuntimeError 'The Element "..." is not registered!' via CreateNewElement. Checking both directions is what makes this a discrimination rather than an existence check. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
